verdict.rationale: Databricks documents several event-driven automation primitives — SQL alerts that 'evaluate conditions and deliver notifications automatically' (databricks-docs-26), Auto Loader/Structured Streaming that react to new data arriving in storage (databricks-docs-13, databricks-docs-51), and Lakeflow pipeline orchestration (databricks-docs-1, databricks-docs-40) — which collectively let a user set up conditions that trigger downstream actions. However, this is scattered across separate tools (alerts, streaming, jobs) rather than a single unified 'rules/automation' engine for arbitrary custom actions, and there is no first-party or independent evidence of a general-purpose event-rule builder (e.g., webhook-style triggers spanning any workspace event) or hands-on confirmation of reliability. Missing for 10: a unified rule-definition interface for arbitrary custom actions, evidence of broader event types (not just data-arrival/query-condition), independent corroboration of alerting/automation reliability.
